unit.why: A single narrative, transmitted in the name of R. Menahem Nahum of Chernobyl, about a childless merchant whom the Besht advises, whose wayward son is transformed, and who meets the prophet Jonah in disguise.

stories.start_quote: שמענו בשם הרב הק' מ' מנחם נחום
stories.end_quote: ואמר שזהו יונה בן אמתי ע"ה
stories.summary_en: A childless rich merchant reluctantly visits the Besht, who tells him to take a lease from a Jew-hating nobleman and promises him a son; the son grows up wild, so the Besht sends him away on a year of travel, during which a mysterious host in a forest house buys his goods and later pays in full, and this host, 'Jonah', turns out to be the prophet Jonah son of Amittai, while the son becomes a diligent scholar.
